data.statement: The test cartridge shall remain closed throughout the collection sequence.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inspect seal position before and after every run; any open state fails the run.
data.failure_disposition: Seal wear can invalidate collection evidence.

data.statement: The chamber controller shall inhibit a sequence outside the approved pressure envelope.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inject out-of-envelope pressure and observe inhibition before actuator enable.
data.failure_disposition: A failed sensor must not be interpreted as nominal pressure.

data.statement: The heater controller shall stop heating when the configured temperature limit is reached.
data.acceptance_criterion: Command heating at the configured limit and verify shutdown within one control cycle.
data.failure_disposition: Temperature overshoot requires a documented disposition.

data.statement: Actuator power shall require an independent enabled interlock.
data.acceptance_criterion: Remove interlock permission and verify zero actuator-enable commands.
data.failure_disposition: Software permission alone is insufficient.

data.statement: An emergency-stop request shall supersede an active extraction command.
data.acceptance_criterion: Issue emergency stop during each sequence state and verify a latched stop.
data.failure_disposition: Reset shall not resume the interrupted sequence.

data.statement: Every sample container shall carry a unique identifier linked to its run.
data.acceptance_criterion: Reconcile all collected containers to run identifiers with no duplicates.
data.failure_disposition: Unidentified material is excluded from reported recovery.

data.statement: Each material campaign shall include an empty-cartridge blank run.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify blank-run completion and contamination disposition before material runs.
data.failure_disposition: A contaminated blank invalidates subsequent interpretation.

data.statement: The run record shall include input, recovered, retained, and unaccounted mass.
data.acceptance_criterion: Confirm the four quantities reconcile within the approved balance tolerance.
data.failure_disposition: Unaccounted mass is not recovered product.

data.statement: Controller and instrument events shall share a synchronized run clock.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify clock offset is no greater than 100 milliseconds in the acceptance run.
data.failure_disposition: Misaligned events can reverse apparent causality.

data.statement: The controller shall flag any telemetry gap longer than two seconds.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inject a three-second gap and verify a flagged run-quality event.
data.failure_disposition: A flagged gap requires review before accepting results.

data.statement: The run header shall record controller, cartridge, and sensor revisions.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify complete revision fields on every accepted run.
data.failure_disposition: Mixed revisions prevent comparable campaign results.

data.statement: Mass and temperature measurements shall use current approved calibrations.
data.acceptance_criterion: Reject an expired calibration during pre-run checks.
data.failure_disposition: Calibration drift can be mistaken for extraction improvement.

data.statement: Restart after an abort shall require a new pre-run checklist.
data.acceptance_criterion: Attempt direct resume after abort and verify rejection.
data.failure_disposition: An interrupted run shall retain its original failed status.

data.statement: Exported run data shall include units, channel names, and quality flags.
data.acceptance_criterion: Reimport a completed run and compare all channel metadata and flags.
data.failure_disposition: Numeric values without units are not acceptable evidence.

data.statement: Only an authorized operator shall acknowledge a safety hold.
data.acceptance_criterion: Attempt acknowledgment with a read-only account and verify denial.
data.failure_disposition: A hold is not cleared by changing the view.

data.statement: A development release shall include a signed verification matrix.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify every requirement has a method, result, owner, and disposition.
data.failure_disposition: Open critical failures block release to the next test campaign.

data.statement: Each analysis shall record the input catalog name, revision, and ingestion date.
data.acceptance_criterion: Open a saved analysis and verify that all three identifiers are retained.
data.failure_disposition: A changed catalog can alter ranking independently of algorithm changes.

data.statement: The importer shall reject mixed units that have not been explicitly mapped.
data.acceptance_criterion: Submit an unmapped mixed-unit dataset and verify an actionable rejection.
data.failure_disposition: Implicit conversion is not permitted.

data.statement: A missing required input shall produce an excluded-target reason.
data.acceptance_criterion: Remove a required field and verify exclusion with the field name.
data.failure_disposition: A missing value shall not be treated as zero.

data.statement: Each run shall retain the constraint set used for target screening.
data.acceptance_criterion: Reopen a run and compare every saved constraint to its exported record.
data.failure_disposition: Unsaved edits shall not alter accepted results.

data.statement: A target ranking shall display its input-uncertainty classification.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify classifications remain attached to all targets after sorting.
data.failure_disposition: Ranking position alone is not resource evidence.

data.statement: Analysts shall be able to retain more than one composition interpretation.
data.acceptance_criterion: Save two interpretations and verify both remain separately addressable.
data.failure_disposition: Alternative interpretations shall not be averaged silently.

data.statement: Identical inputs and configuration shall produce identical ordered outputs.
data.acceptance_criterion: Compare two runs byte-for-byte after excluding creation timestamps.
data.failure_disposition: Nondeterministic ordering blocks comparison acceptance.

data.statement: An analysis shall record the solver and scoring-model versions.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inspect a completed export and confirm both version identifiers.
data.failure_disposition: A version upgrade shall not rewrite historical analyses.

data.statement: Screening results shall distinguish feasible, excluded, and unresolved targets.
data.acceptance_criterion: Exercise all three states and verify separate labels and reasons.
data.failure_disposition: Unresolved shall not be presented as feasible.

data.statement: Analysts shall be able to compare approved constraint variations.
data.acceptance_criterion: Run two named constraint sets and verify a labeled comparison.
data.failure_disposition: Sensitivity outputs are not mission commitments.

data.statement: Accepted analyses shall retain author, reviewer, and acceptance time.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify an accepted analysis has all three fields and a review disposition.
data.failure_disposition: Unreviewed runs retain draft analysis status.

data.statement: The exporter shall produce a versioned tabular schema.
data.acceptance_criterion: Validate exported columns against the registered schema version.
data.failure_disposition: A changed column name requires a schema revision.

data.statement: Out-of-range values shall be rejected with the target identifier.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inject an out-of-range input and verify the identifier in the error.
data.failure_disposition: The importer shall not silently clamp data.

data.statement: Accepted analysis workflows shall run without an external network dependency.
data.acceptance_criterion: Disconnect network access and complete a reference analysis.
data.failure_disposition: An optional catalog update is not part of acceptance.

data.statement: A comparison shall identify changes in both inputs and configuration.
data.acceptance_criterion: Change one input and one setting and verify both change classes.
data.failure_disposition: An apparent improvement requires a traceable changed variable.

data.statement: A development release shall include reviewed reference-case results.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify reference cases, expected outcomes, discrepancies, and approvals.
data.failure_disposition: Open discrepancies require disposition before release.

data.statement: The test cartridge shall remain closed throughout the collection sequence.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inspect seal position before and after every run; any open state fails the run.
data.failure_disposition: Seal wear can invalidate collection evidence.

data.statement: The chamber controller shall inhibit a sequence outside the approved pressure envelope.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inject out-of-envelope pressure and observe inhibition before actuator enable.
data.failure_disposition: A failed sensor must not be interpreted as nominal pressure.

data.statement: The heater controller shall stop heating when the configured temperature limit is reached.
data.acceptance_criterion: Command heating at the configured limit and verify shutdown within one control cycle.
data.failure_disposition: Temperature overshoot requires a documented disposition.

data.statement: Actuator power shall require an independent enabled interlock.
data.acceptance_criterion: Remove interlock permission and verify zero actuator-enable commands.
data.failure_disposition: Software permission alone is insufficient.

data.statement: An emergency-stop request shall supersede an active extraction command.
data.acceptance_criterion: Issue emergency stop during each sequence state and verify a latched stop.
data.failure_disposition: Reset shall not resume the interrupted sequence.

data.statement: Every sample container shall carry a unique identifier linked to its run.
data.acceptance_criterion: Reconcile all collected containers to run identifiers with no duplicates.
data.failure_disposition: Unidentified material is excluded from reported recovery.

data.statement: Each material campaign shall include an empty-cartridge blank run.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify blank-run completion and contamination disposition before material runs.
data.failure_disposition: A contaminated blank invalidates subsequent interpretation.

data.statement: The run record shall include input, recovered, retained, and unaccounted mass.
data.acceptance_criterion: Confirm the four quantities reconcile within the approved balance tolerance.
data.failure_disposition: Unaccounted mass is not recovered product.

data.statement: Controller and instrument events shall share a synchronized run clock.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify clock offset is no greater than 100 milliseconds in the acceptance run.
data.failure_disposition: Misaligned events can reverse apparent causality.

data.statement: The controller shall flag any telemetry gap longer than two seconds.
data.acceptance_criterion: Inject a three-second gap and verify a flagged run-quality event.
data.failure_disposition: A flagged gap requires review before accepting results.

data.statement: The run header shall record controller, cartridge, and sensor revisions.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify complete revision fields on every accepted run.
data.failure_disposition: Mixed revisions prevent comparable campaign results.

data.statement: Mass and temperature measurements shall use current approved calibrations.
data.acceptance_criterion: Reject an expired calibration during pre-run checks.
data.failure_disposition: Calibration drift can be mistaken for extraction improvement.

data.statement: Restart after an abort shall require a new pre-run checklist.
data.acceptance_criterion: Attempt direct resume after abort and verify rejection.
data.failure_disposition: An interrupted run shall retain its original failed status.

data.statement: Exported run data shall include units, channel names, and quality flags.
data.acceptance_criterion: Reimport a completed run and compare all channel metadata and flags.
data.failure_disposition: Numeric values without units are not acceptable evidence.

data.statement: Only an authorized operator shall acknowledge a safety hold.
data.acceptance_criterion: Attempt acknowledgment with a read-only account and verify denial.
data.failure_disposition: A hold is not cleared by changing the view.

data.statement: A development release shall include a signed verification matrix.
data.acceptance_criterion: Verify every requirement has a method, result, owner, and disposition.
data.failure_disposition: Open critical failures block release to the next test campaign.
